avis.texte: I have combination and textured skin. This product not only removes all of my makeup but it makes my skin so smooth. If I dont use it for a day, I notice the texture coming back and black heads. I use it daily on my sensitive skin and have no issues. Highly recommend
i bought this because its advertised as light but it was so thick and sticky i felt like i was pulling on my skin. i'm going to keep buying my Anua cleanser

i bought this when i thought i had oily skin (its actually combination) so i wont be repurchasing. however, this product removes makeup effectively and does wonders for my waterproof mascara. my one issue was that the pump on the bottle was finnicky for me, so i transfered to a different bottle. the product itself was effectice and nonstripping, however.

avis.titre: fell in love after one use!
avis.texte: I just received this in my ULTA order that arrived today. I used it on dirty but no makeup skin using the oil gritting method (massage oil into dry skin for 15-20 minutes). Oh my goodness - it cleared most of my sebaceous filaments in my cheeks and chin in one use! My nose is a bit more stubborn and will probably need more consistent use to fully remove the filaments. It smells PHENOMENAL; it's a natural herbal citrus scent that's remniscent of professional spa treatments. Lightweight formula and glides across the skin. I used about three pumps and it did not drag at all. I have not used it for makeup removal yet, but the consistency and the way it broke my sebaceous filaments down make me feel like it will do a great job on that too. Oh, and a bonus - it does NOT sting my eyes!!!! I am happy to have added this to my skincare arsenal as I prepare for my upcoming summer wedding.

avis.titre: not good for acne prone skin
avis.texte: I used this product for about 3 weeks when my face began to break out in painful spots in a way it has never done before.

i've used this cleanser for about two weeks now, and i personally really enjoy it! i have sebaceous filaments from an oily t zone, and i have been oil cleansing with this on my nose for about 3 minutes and most of my nose is clear :) it's really light and doesn't leave an oily feeling and easy to rinse off. i use the pha oil for removing makup since it's more gentle, and go in with this one to actually cleanse my face.
Honestly i prefer the DHC one. This one stings my eyes which sucks bc i didnt want to have to use a different cleanser for the eyes. It is a thinner oil.

I've been using this product for over a month. I have sensitive, reactive, acne prone, combo skin and I really wanted to love this, but i don't see much improvement. It don't emulsify well, although it does leave my skin soft. It's on the thinner side of cleansing oils (as opposed to say DHC), and I haven't seen much change in my texture, but I'll keep using it as nothing has seemed to worsen, which for me, is a W. Hope to return with a better update in a few.

avis.titre: Amazing cleansing oil for oily skin
avis.texte: I decided to try this simply because I LOVE their cleansing balm- BHA. This works as good as the balm. I just switch around between two products. - The days with heavy makeup, I go for balm and the days with light or no makeup, I use the oil. Both works great. LOVE LOVE LOVE

I have both the balm and oil from this brand. I really like both of them. - they work great on my super oily skin. My blackheads disappeared after a few washes. My skin is less oily when I use this product. I would highly recommend this cleansing oil for anyone who has severe oily skin.

The 1st ingredient is water... which isn't something you'd expect to find in a 1st cleanse, in which one would apply to a dry face & then emulsify with water. This is more of a thin gel. Definitely not an oil cleanser. Also it has a strong herbal stench which I don't really appreciate. It also feels cool on the skin when applied. Not great. I'm sure there's oil somewhere in its ingredient list, making it an oil containing cleanser but, this is most emphatically not an oil cleanser.

Was super excited to try this but ended up kinda disappointed. I have tried dozens of cleansing oils and balms and was looking to try something with BHAs in it. The bottle and price point are great, and I believe it probably works well for many people. However for me, it is super watery and doesn't work into my skin like other products do. It doesn't feel like an oil or emulsify; however, it doesn't leave behind a film which is a positive.

I love the PHA version of this cleansing oil and have been using it for about two years. There was a recent Hanskin sale and I was already running low on the hyaluron moisturizer that I love so I thought I would give this a try, plus a few other things. I have to say, I'm once again, very impressed with the results. I've been using this as the first step of my night time routine in combination with the Hyaluron Bubble Pop Foam cleanser and I haven't found a better duo for my summer skincare routine! I have combination skin and with the right serum this stuff given me petal soft, glassy skin! In the winter I will probably switch back to the PHA version and a gentler cleanser, but this stuff is amazing. I've found using BHA cleansing oils and essence toners have been the best combatant to summer acne for my dry/oily combination skin.

So, I've only used this cleanser once-but so far, I love it! I'm usually able to get an idea on wether a cleanser will work for me right off the bat. This cleanser is gentle, but still super effective. It removed ALL of my eye makeup and left my skin feeling soft and clean. I followed it with another cleanser, and I'm satisfied so far.

avis.titre: Light, nice smelling- what I was looking for
avis.texte: Am enjoying this oil cleanser so far! It should be made clear on Ulta's website but on the Hanskin website it says that this cleanser should be followed by a water-based cleanser as part of a two step process. There have been times I haven't done this and I think you can easily go without step 2 since it doesn't leave an oily feel afterwards. For me the two step makes my skin feel "too clean". Im very particular about fragrances in face products and really like how this smells expensive and its very subtle- slightly citrusy maybe. Would recommend and will probably buy again.

avis.titre: Great cleanser that leaves skin silky smooth
avis.texte: I use this product in the shower in the mornings to cleanse my face. I love the citrus scent. I have sensitive skin; this product works for me. It leaves my skin silky smooth after using it.

avis.titre: Highly Recommended! I will buy this product again.
avis.texte: Smooth and so soft to my skin. I love how great this product to my skin while still being effective. You don't get a stinging or burning sensation like other products I've used. I highly recommend it if your looking for something to improve your skins texture while also keeping it glow!

This cleanser is really gentle and has an oil/water like consistency. It wipes away all of my makeup without feeling harsh on my skin. There is a slight citrus smell, which for me I really liked. It's a staple! If you're looking for a cleanser I definitely recommend.

Good oil based cleanser that doesn't leave a very slick oily feeling after. I usually use a foaming cleanser after this to really get my skin clean. There is minimal scent to it which I like since I have sensitive skin. Great buy for its price point.

I really enjoyed this oil cleanser as a first step of my cleansing routine. Because it is exfoliating I only use it twice a week. I like how gentile it is while still being effective. You don't get a stinging or burning sensation like other products I've tried. I highly recommend it if your looking for something to improve your skins texture while also keeping it glowy and clear!

This is a pretty good oil cleanser, and I have used many in the past. I like using it especially in the winter time. My skin is pretty dry in the winter and I feel like it doesn't strip my skin while still making it feel clean. It has a pretty citrusy smell, so if you're sensitive to scents I would not get it. Overall, I really like this cleanser and I would recommend it.

Really easy to use since it has a pump which I appreciate. I mix it with some water to emulsify it and it works like magic.I follow up with a foaming cleanser and I don't feel any residual oil left on my skin.

avis.titre: Great for makeup removal & oily skin
avis.texte: I use this every night for removing my makeup & just cleansing my face overall. I see that my skin doesn't get too clogged or oily after I use this. Very smooth to put on my face & is nice and milky.

I'm adamant about double cleansing at night and use this as a first cleanser. Takes off makeup well. Realized it is for oily skin so I gave it to my sister to use as I have dry skin and purchased the aha version instead. It is a mild exfoliate so that is a plus.

I've tried Hanskin's AHA oil cleanser, so I was really excited to try this product. This cleanser is amazing and leaves me feeling clean and refreshed. It is oil-based, so it takes a little longer to wash off the product. Otherwise, I would definitely recommend it to a friend!

I love this cleansing oil! I've used a much thinner one before and had trouble removing waterproof mascara - this oil is super thick and literally dissolved my makeup when using it on dry skin. It has an herbal medicinal smell which I actually really like, and I thought it rinsed off clean. My only complaint is the pump has a very short spring so it causes some excess to drip out if I'm not careful when pumping. Otherwise highly recommend.
I have been trying to find a cleansing oil forever and this one i just love

I have used multiple products from Hanskin and this is one of my favorites. It doesn't disappoint. It cleans off my sunscreen and makeup, doesn't leave a greasy film. I have normal dry combo skin and I really enjoy the consistency of this product. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: Good for sensitive and dry skin
avis.texte: After using this product for a month, it has left my skin super soft and smooth. It gives your face a nice dewy and glowy look! The only con I have is that is has an unpleasant smell.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: After using this product for a month, it has left my skin so so soft. The only problem I have with this product is that it has an unpleasant smell for me.

avis.titre: Effective Cleansing Oil for Dry skin
avis.texte: I have used multiple Hanskin products over the past two years and have enjoyed each of them. This one is another star. It's lightweight, doesn't feel too greasy on your skin. As someone with normal dry combo skin I appreciate it, especially with colder weather coming to the east coast. A little goes a long way! Highly recommend.

I've used Hanskin's PHA Cleansing Oil and really liked it and this one is another winner! It's not harsh, but does a good job of removing makeup and cleaning my skin. The only downside is that it made my eyes burn a little bit when I was removing my eye makeup, which isn't a big deal (I was able to wash it out of my eyes no problem) but the other Hanskin Oil Cleanser doesn't burn my eyes at all. Not a deal breaker, but something to consider. Overall, I'd recommend this product!

avis.titre: This is a great cleansing oil!
avis.texte: This cleansing oil is great! I love the sweet smell. I have combo skin and was expecting my skin to be dried out but it keeps it moisturized well. This is really great if you have hard-to-get-off makeup too! I really like this product! Thanks Hanskin!

This is the second Hanskin Pore cleansing oil i own! This product works great to use as the first step in the 2 step cleansing routine. It effectively removes all of my makeup (including pesky waterproof makeup) with one pump. The product feels clean on the skin and is really easy to wash off. My skin feels moisturized after I use this product. Hanskin is my new go-to for simple skincare!

I really enjoy using this as a precleanse step in my skincare routine. It removes makeup well, even eye makeup. It has an herbal scent like some sort of essential oil, and when wet turns into an easy to rinse away milk. It is very moisturizing, although better for oily skin than the other versions of this cleansing oil. Will keep using this!

This product is good at removing the first layer of makeup or oils your skin produces. It's best to use in combination with other products such as a water based cleanser to ensure all the oils are gone. It take some elbow grease to use.
As someone with very dry skin, it didn't strip my skin of moisture and did cleanse well. It also did help a little with maskne. Pleasantly surprised with this oil.

I love how it removes makeup and all the other nasty stuff from the face. I was skeptical to use at first because I have sensitive skin but it worked so well. I didn't break out and my face felt like a baby's butt! I definitely recommend!

I use this as my first step cleanser and I love how it easily removes my make up and keeps my face hydrated and smooth! I break out easily in the t zone area, but since I started this cleanser I noticed that it has cut down a lot. There is a light scent to it but other than that it always leaves my face feeling clean and refreshed! Also I love that there's a pump, it makes it super convenient.

I think this cleansing oil does what it needs to. It takes off all of my makeup and prefer it over the solid balm as I feel the design is definitely more hygenic overall. However, I would say I like the original oil better the one in the orange bottle because although this one says it is fresh and light, I do feel like the BHA can cause a bit of sensitivity on my face. Overall, I liked this oil and didn't mind the smell!

This worked well to take off my makeup. I like the light herbal scent and it didn't feel like it stripped my skin. To remove makeup I think I prefer a cleansing balm to a cleansing oil. The oil is not thick enough to make sure I get enough product around my eyes to remove my mascara. If I use more product then it ends up working.

avis.titre: Love how it removes makeup and sebum. Great for oily skin
avis.texte: I like how easily you can rub the oil around to remove face and eye makeup. I always rinse and then use a foam cleanser after anyways. I don't think you're supposed to use this alone. Most cleansing oils and balm are supposed to just give you the first step for deep cleaning routine. I like how its much cheaper than skii cleansing oil and does the same thing.

avis.titre: Gentle and lovely first cleanse oil
avis.texte: I've been using this product for a few weeks and am loving it as a first cleanse. It really removes my makeup and sunscreen with out stripping my skin of it's natural oils. After washing it off, it leaves my skin soft, smooth and supple. The smell is lovely and transports me to a spa vibe. I would recommend this and buy this again.

This is a pretty great cleanser. It's light and leaves skin feeling clean and smooth. It's a very light smell and doesn't have any artificial fragrance which I like. You do have to rinse pretty thoroughly and I think I have drier skin so the oil definitely helped with that. Not sure how it would work with already really oily skin.

avis.titre: Exactly what I was looking for!
avis.texte: I like to gently massage the product into my skin and let it work its magic! It takes off waterproof mascara really well! I use this every night and I love it!

I have oily skin so this worked well for me! The scent was a nice lemon, tea tree oil scent. I think it can be drying for faces that are not as oily, but again this product is for oily skin types. I noticed it does sting my eyes a bit, so it is better to remove eye makeup first. I am enjoying this product so far and would explore more Hanskin products.

avis.titre: Perfect first step in my nightly routine!
avis.texte: I always start my nightly routine with an oil cleanser, and this is amazing! After I remove my eye makeup separately, I use it on a dry face, and it removed my foundation and other impurities from the day from my face. It makes my skin feel clean without making it feel dry or tight, which is what I am looking for in this step. This cleanser is actually for oily skin (as the bottle states), but my husband, who has dry skin, likes it just as much. The product does have a light smell as some others commented, but I actually do not mind it - it is kind of relaxing. Definitely for the price point, the product is well worth it!

I really loved the AHA Cleaning Oil and this BHA one works just as well! It does a great job of cleaning off light make-up and leaves my skin feeling hydrated every time I use it. Now that it is the fall and winter is coming along, it'll definitely be a product i'll be using frequently.
My husband recently started using this product and we can definitely notice a difference in how oily his face usually gets by the end of the day. Would definitely recommend

I like this oil, I just feel like there are better. I think the bha might be a little strong, and definitely don't leave it on because it will sting. Overall, removes makeup well, just not my favorite.

avis.titre: I don't use makeup, but it does work well as a pore cleaner.
avis.texte: I don't wear any makeup, but my skin does get fairly oily. It seemed to work well with helping to remove excess oil. The package warns of increased sensitivity to sunlight, so I stuck to using it in the evening, and it works well enough.

I have had trouble with blackheads my entire life- and a few blemishes here and there. I have oily combination skin. (mostly oiler in t-zone area) I am also an aesthetician so I have seriously tried everything under the sun it feels like. I got a small bottle of this sent to me as an extra gift from a friend and I cannot live without it now. My pores are clear- I honestly don't know how anyone can not like this product. Especially if they are acne prone. The beta hydroxy acid, a.k.a. salicylic acid, DOES NOT MAKE ACNE WORSE. I'm just stunned to read some of these reviews. If people think they are breaking out from this product, it has to be because they are putting something else on their face that isn't agreeing. This formula and all of the ingredients in it are made strictly to HELP acne- prone skin. I put a little on my dry face before I shower every day. I love love love this product!!

I'm pretty sure this is the product that's dried my skin out completely and caused my skin to break out so badly. I have to go my dermatologist to try to get some kind of help with calming it down but I'm super disappointed.

i wouldn't repurchase but a lot came in the bottle. it leaks from the top sadly. it also soaks into ur skin and i have to apply like five to six pumps to get a nice layer on to massage. it doesn't emulsify like other oil cleansers i've used, and i feel like it made my acne worse. I'll use this every once in a while, maybe to take my makeup off but i like the DHC one better. the rest of the reviews probably have never seen what an actual oil cleanser is suppose be like, but this one isn't it. it's like putting straight vegetable oil on but thinner and it soaks in your skin, instead of cleaning the impurities.

Pre cleanse. It burnt trying to remove my eye make up , so you def would have to remove eye make before with another product . It does contain actives and that's no lie . I would not recommend this product to nobody with combination skin , ONLY OILY Skin . I'll only use this on oilier days no more than once a week . Maybe more often in warmer months . I was terrified I wrecked my barrier after pre cleansing with this for the first time . I tried it out a second time (only on my problem areas) and it wasn't as harsh but I made sure to wipe it all off before moving on to my water (second) cleanse . Just make sure you HYDRATE HYDRATE HYDRATE after using this !

avis.titre: Did what it said it would!
avis.texte: I use this at night to clean off my make-up. Micellular water usually works well for me- but this works better and faster! I quickly realized to only use a few times per week though, otherwise my skin gets irritated. I have sensitive to normal skin. I did see an instant clearing of some of that gross sebum stuff!

I first found Hanskin on Soko Glam and tried out their PHA oil because I wanted something gentler first. I love, love that one. The PHA one doesn't match my skin needs entirely but it works wonderfully as a first cleanse. This one, however, doesn't emulsify (no milky afterwash), has a slightly thicker consistency, smells much less appealing than the PHA one, and I don't know if it even works on my oily skin even though it says it does. When I apply it to my skin, the oil seems to disappear a little and my palms/fingers end up dragging on my skin as if I need to apply more product. It's unlike the PHA where I pump 1-2 times and can massage the oil onto my skin for at least a minute; for the PHA it feels like I can gently rub the oil to get it to interact with the surface of my skin. Maybe my skin is absorbing a lot of the BHA? Granted, BHA works differently than PHA so the effects and overall experience while using it may be different. I'll keep using it and update later, but I'm a little worried the bottle I received went bad somehow(??) because it smells so off from the PHA.

avis.titre: Gentle on sensitive skin, but need to rinse thoroughly
avis.texte: I used it daily - morning and night. I found it so gentle on my sensitive skin and didn't leave my skin "bare" or "stripped". I would recommend it do anyone with combo skin or dry skin -- really does leave your skin hydrated without residue. I do think it helps to rinse thoroughly to give you that "fully cleansed" feeling vs. oil is left over. Other than that, I'd highly recommend massaging your face as you cleanse -- helps to relax at night.

I've been using this product as the first step to taking off my makeup for 2 weeks now. It's very effective in melting off all of my makeup and easy to wash off ( this is a big plus for me as i really dislike oil cleansers that are super hard to wash off...time is precious! haha). I use it even when I just have sunscreen on. TMI but I can feel the sebum coming out of my pores o.O. The only con is the smell, I think it's really refreshing but people who are sensitive to smell could find it a bit strong. Otherwise a super awesome product!

I have never used any kind of oil product for my face, but now I cannot imagine my skin without this product. I have been using this before my normal cleanser for the past week, and my face is SO GLOWY! The smell is also so soothing for night time, and the pump makes it especially easy to use as well. If you are on the edge of purchasing, I'd say just go for it!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I normally am not a fan of oil cleansers, but this product left my skin soft.

I have extremely oily skin and was skeptical about oil cleansing, so I decided to try this product because of the BHA formulation for my skin type. I am not only impressed with the way it removes makeup, but how much smoother my skin feels after I've finished using the product is impressive. I highly recommend this product to anyone with oily skin who is interested in giving a cleansing oil a try.

I've been using this for around a month to double cleanse. I follow with a normal cleanser and I think my face gets really clean. It's AMAZING for removing face make up but don't put it on your eyes!!! It gets the make up off but burns badly I think because of the BHA As for pore cleansing I haven't noticed a difference in my blackheads or clogged pores 🤷‍♀️ May try something else when I finish it

avis.titre: I wanted to like this, but...
avis.texte: I first heard about the brand on soko glam & glad to see it carried here. You get a lot of product & it will last you for a long time. I purchased this back in December, it is now July & I still have some to use up. I like how this is catered to my oily skin type. However, this stings my eyes. It does not emulsify at all. Not a formula that I like. I don't see the effectiveness or benefits it has done for me. After I finish this, I'm moving on to another product.

I use two to three pumps if this each evening to remove my makeup/grime from the day. This is my first cleanse in a double cleansing routine. The smell and concept is very much like Dermalogica's PreCleanse, but the price of this oil in much more affordable. The consistency is slightly thicker than PreCleanse as well. Overall I'm very happy with the product. My skin looks great!

I started using this product every morning and evening as the first step in my routine, and I immediately noticed that my skin felt much cleaner than usual. I wipe and then rub the product over my face and once I rinse my skin feels like all the dirt as actually been rinsed off! I am really happy with the product, and it isn't leaving my skin care routine any time soon :)
The overall condition of my face has improved since I started using it.
My skin feels smooth, clean, and hydrated. I love this stuff!

This is the best face oil I've tried. It's a thicker consistency than others I've tried and gets all my makeup off including waterproof eye makeup. I use this as a first step followed by a mild soap cleanser. The best part is that it doesnt leave a residue that stings my eyes like other face oils. the only con for me is the smell. It has a subtle patchouli smell mixed with citrus.

I have extremely oily skin, blackheads, acne, and huge pores. This cleanser has been awesome for helping control my oil production during the day, which in turn helps my blackheads and shrink my pores. A lot of oil cleansers I've tried are very heavy, but this one is very light and still leaves my skin soft after I use it. Will definitely be buying more!

I wanted something that could help with the blackheads on my nose. Now nothing is going to completely suck them right out but this cleanser *does* decrease the "black-ness" of them. I have normal skin, not super acne prone. My face is on the dry side, but my nose gets oily. I don't find this cleanser to be drying or leave a residue. I rub in 2 pumps, then slightly wet my fingers with water to emulsify it. Works great!

I love the smells its like lemon and lavender. i have combo skin type but thats work really good .Its removes makeup really well and melts all the makeup fast. i love this product cuz its affordable and huge bottled.
This has a nice thick consistency to it. I pair this with the Ahava sea mud cleaning bar for my hormonal break outs, and it's been working wonders for me!!
I love the smell. I use this a step 1 to wash off my makeup. Works great!

Since it's so dry right now, my skin has been dehydrated. But, the cleanser I was using was a little harsh. I've heard a lot about oil cleansers, but thought they'd block my pores. I gave this one a try, and love it. It removes makeup quickly, and leaves my skin feeling soft. Someone else mentioned a residue, but I think that might just be the oil hydrating my skin. My skin feels softer after using this product twice a day. I'd recommend it.

-Sunk in/evaporated too fast and required adding more to maintain adequate slip for massage -Did not emulsify well and left a residue -Left my skin feeling oily but dehydrated -Broke my skin out in pustules
At Ulta. I have compo skin and this gentle BHA has been a great oil cleanser for my two step cleansing. I have noticed a difference in my whiteheads clearing up on my chin and it.smells.amazing!
